policy: Fixed positive RNG seeds shared by method; development seeds 0 and 1001-1010 are excluded from final repeat campaigns.
ompl_note: OMPL does not accept seed zero. Positive seeds avoid its implicit zero-to-one substitution.
development_note: Earlier exploratory low-DOF runs used seeds 0 and 1; manipulator diagnostics also used problem-index seeds. Registered repeat seeds therefore overlap with some development runs. Reports must disclose this overlap and must not call them entirely unseen trials.
final_v7_note: Held-out final seeds, never used for development or tuning before the v7 freeze (2026-11-24).
final_v8_note: Held-out v8 seeds registered on 2026-11-24 before any v8 run; never used for development or tuning (development used 1001-1010).
final_v9_note: Held-out v9 seeds registered on 2026-11-24 before any v9 run; development used 1001-1010.
final_v10_note: Held-out v10 seeds registered on 2026-11-25 (PC i9-14900) before any v10 run; development used 1001-1010.
final_v10b_note: Held-out v10b seeds registered on 2026-11-25 before any v10b run (after v10 results on 5001+ were seen; v10b reruns the uncontrolled Table I stage and the repeat/stability pairs on fresh seeds; no parameter changed between v10 and v10b except the post-hoc interval oracle, which gained Quad2D |v|/|omega| limits).
